_readme: Margins in pixels at 1x for the sample files. Same data as the full pack.

bar_256x32.note: 3-slice horizontal. The pointed end caps are 24 px; top and bottom are half the height only so Godot accepts the margins. Fill files are drawn for 256 px; for other widths use TextureProgressBar nine-patch stretch with the same margins.

menu_button_wide.note: 3-slice horizontal (pointed ends are 24 px). Top and bottom are half the height only so Godot accepts the margins. The two gems are in the end caps.
